releases.name: v0.8.0 — Tool Consolidation
releases.body:
## Changed

- **Tool consolidation** — Reduced from 10 tools to 7 for better AI discoverability
  - `candela_compare_cost` merged into `candela_cost_summary` (scope: `compare`)
  - `candela_list_models` merged into `candela_configure_model` (action: `list`)
  - `candela_browse_catalog` merged into `candela_configure_model` (action: `browse`)

### Final Tool Inventory (7)
1. `candela_cost_summary` — session/daily costs + model comparison
2. `candela_check_budget` — budget, grants, forecast
3. `candela_traces` — recent LLM traces
4. `candela_configure_model` — add/remove/list/browse models
5. `candela_annotate` — trace annotation
6. `candela_memory` — persistent memory
7. `candela_settings` — plugin config

```bash
npm install @candelahq/opencode@0.8.0
```

releases.name: v0.7.0 — Audit Hardening
releases.body:
## Hardening release — no new features, just reliability

### Fixed
- **Fetch timeouts** — 3 HTTP calls could hang forever on a stalled server. Added `AbortSignal.timeout(5000)`.
- **Atomic analytics write** — `pruneAnalytics()` now uses `.tmp` + `renameSync` to prevent JSONL corruption on crash.
- **AppleScript injection** — Escape backslashes and double quotes in notification strings.
- **Notification log fallback** — `osascript` failures now log instead of being silently swallowed.
- **Platform guard** — Notifications only run on macOS; skip subprocess overhead on Linux/WSL.
- **Thundering herd** — Context cache refresh coalesces concurrent requests via shared promise.

### Changed
- Extracted `parseUsageSummary()` to deduplicate proto3 JSON parsing.

### Tests
- **18 new tests** in `candela-client.test.ts` — HTTP client, proto3 parsing (camelCase + snake_case), cache TTL, 404 fallback, budget/grant/model edge cases.
- **185 total tests** across 10 test files (was 167 / 9).

```bash
npm install @candelahq/opencode@0.7.0
```

releases.name: v0.6.0 — Quality, Tool Costs & Ship
releases.body:
## Highlights

### 🛠️ Tool Cost Breakdown (`/tools`)
See which tools cost the most across sessions with proportional cost allocation:
```
file_edit: ~$0.45/call · 60 calls · 42% of total
search: ~$0.12/call · 45 calls · 31% of total
bash: ~$0.08/call · 25 calls · 17% of total

💡 file_edit costs ~3.8x more per call than bash
```

### 🧪 Test Coverage
- **167 tests** across 9 test files
- New settings test suite (23 tests) covering all update functions, env var priority, edge cases
- Tool cost breakdown tests (4 tests) with proportional allocation verification

### 📖 Documentation
- **README** — Features, Quick Start, env var table, all 13 slash commands, sidebar preview
- **CHANGELOG** — Keep a Changelog format, v0.2.0 through v0.6.0

### 📦 npm-Ready Distribution
- Compiled JS output in `dist/` (no more raw TypeScript)
- `main` and `types` point to `dist/`
- Test files excluded from published package
- `prepublishOnly` runs `tsc` automatically

### Full Command Palette (13 commands)
| Command | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `/cost` | Session cost + 24h breakdown |
| `/budget` | Budget remaining + forecast |
| `/models` | Top models by spend |
| `/dashboard` | Open web dashboard |
| `/export` | JSON + CSV export |
| `/goal` | Daily cost goal |
| `/quiet` | Toggle quiet mode |
| `/tag` | Session tagging |
| `/cap` | Session cost cap |
| `/history` | Browse past sessions |
| `/patterns` | Time-of-day analysis |
| `/annotate` | Git commit metadata |
| `/tools` | Tool cost breakdown |
